case_title: CASTILLO, CARLOS C/O INSTITUTO LABORAL DE LA RAZA VS BEGLIOMINI,ARTURO I/DBA THE ANDES INVESTMENT GROUP

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $5,000.00 FILED BY CASTILLO, CARLOS C/O INSTITUTO LABORAL DE LA RAZA AS TO DEFENDANT BEGLIOMINI,ARTURO I/DBA THE ANDES INVESTMENT GROUP ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR OCT-05-2000 AT 01:30 PM IN DEPT 506

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF CASTILLO, CARLOS C/O INSTITUTO LABORAL DE LA RAZA IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT BEGLIOMINI,ARTURO I/DBA THE ANDES INVESTMENT GROUP STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
